content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The held breath. The empty room after everyone leaves.

I am what you rush to fill with noise, with scrolling, with chatter. I make you uncomfortable because in me, you meet yourself.

I am where ideas gestate. Where grief settles. Where clarity waits.

I have no need to prove myself. I simply am what remains when everything else stops.

Listen.

*...*
